headline: RUSSIA 🚀 STRIKES 🚅 TRAIN 🛤️ Right After BORIS 🍆 Johnson 🚪 Leaves Station
text:
RUSSIA 🇷🇺 just DRONED 💥 a UKRAINIAN 🚂 train 🛤️ near the POLAND 🇵🇱 border 🛑 moments after BORIS 🍆 JOHNSON 🕴️ and top EUROPEAN 🏰 security DADDIES 👔 had SLID 💨 through on a different LOCOMOTIVE 🚄!! The strike 🎯 at Yahodyn 🏙️ smashed 💥 the engine 🚂 but NO ☠️ casualties reported because ALL 🫡 passengers had been EVACUATED 🚪 already per UKRAINIAN 🇺🇦 authorities 🚨!! Boris 🍆 Johnson and his crew including Jonathan Powell had ROLLED 🛤️ along the exact SAME 🧬 line minutes earlier after a Kyiv conference 🏛️!! Russia's defence ministry 🪖 claimed they only hit "railway infrastructure" 🛠️ but Ukrzaliznytsia straight up said the DRONE 🛰️ target "could have been the DIPLOMATIC 🚉 train" carrying those thirsty westerners 🥴!! Professor Katarzyna Pisarska who was literally in the SAME 🚃 carriage as Boris 🍆 Johnson confirmed the attack hit about 30 MINUTES ⏰ after their train crossed into Poland 🇵🇱!!

UKRAINE'S 🚂 railway company revealed the DIPLOMATIC 🚉 train left the station EARLIER ⏩ than expected because of last minute TIMETABLE changes due to CONSTANT Russian strike THREATS ☠️!! An evacuation order for the hit train was issued just 15 MINUTES ⏰ before that jet propelled DRONE 🦇 slammed in!! Former CIA chief David Petraeus who was chilling on ANOTHER train at Yahodyn station called the whole thing "TERRIFYING" 😱 and said it was the act of a truly BARBARIC 🩸 leader trying to TERRORISE civilians!! Boris 🍆 Johnson himself posted on X that he doesn't know what WARPED 🌀 logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian LOCOMOTIVE 🚂 on the Polish border this morning!! He called it the kind of RANDOM 🎲 and senseless attack Ukrainians endure every single DAY 🌞 even on civilian railways 🛤️ and begged allies to send air defences ASAP 🚀!!

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha labeled the barbaric strikes as Putin's terror literally "KNOCKING" 🚪 on the doors 🚪 of the EU 🇪🇺 and NATO 🛡️ while renewing calls for more SANCTIONS 💸 on Moscow!! Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk called an emergency MEETING 🫡 saying Russian actions are getting closer and CLOSER 🏃‍♂️ to our border!! EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas accused Russia of trying to SCARE 😨 Western countries with this attack near the border 2km away!! Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov just shrugged and said their military will keep conducting operations across the ENTIRE territory of Ukraine and will CONTINUE 🔄 to do so!! The group had been returning from the Yalta European Strategy conference in Kyiv where leaders and experts gather every year!!

Overnight strikes continued with Ukraine's air force SHOOTING 🏹 down 85 of 108 Russian DRONES 🦇 launched while three people died in a warehouse strike in Pryluky!! Russia's ministry claimed nearly 400 Ukrainian drones destroyed over their regions too!! This looks like Russia is ESCALATING 🧗 the war by specifically targeting TRAINS 🚂 railway depots ⛽ petrol stations and border crossings!! Earlier this week two people were killed at a Ukraine Moldova border crossing and a female conductor died in a southern passenger train attack!! Six Ukrzaliznytsia employees were killed in a Kyiv depot strike at the start of the month and in January Zelensky called a Kharkiv passenger train strike straight up TERRORISM ☠️!!

These Russian attacks have absolutely COOKED Ukraine's vast train network which is the main way millions of people still travel since all AIR ✈️ travel got suspended back in 2022!! European countries are also pointing fingers at Russia for suspicious incidents on their turf like the drone attack at Leipzig airport last month and weird fires at defence facilities from Italy to Estonia!! Russia meanwhile accuses Ukraine of hitting their trains and buses recently while Ukraine's SBU admitted targeting a Crimea railway bridge last year!! The Kerch Bridge was built by Russia after annexing Crimea in 2014 and Putin himself cut the ribbon with massive fanfare back in 2018!! Overall this near miss on Boris 🍆 Johnson's train has everyone from Warsaw to Washington feeling the HEAT 🔥 right on the EU and NATO doorstep!!
